audience: subscription businesses who bill customers and collect payments with ChargeOver

useCases.title: Find unpaid and overdue invoices
useCases.text: The AI searches invoices by status, such as open-unpaid or open-overdue, and by customer. It shows totals and balance, and adds up what is owed.

useCases.title: Check a customer's subscriptions and payments
useCases.text: The AI lists a customer's subscriptions (packages) with cycle and next invoice date, and the payments, refunds and credits that were processed.

useCases.title: Run a saved report
useCases.text: The AI reads a saved report's available filters and columns, then runs it with filters such as a date range and returns the rows.

useCases.title: Review items, coupons, usage and notes
useCases.text: The AI lists items with pricing tiers, coupons, metered usage data in a date range, and notes attached to customers, invoices or subscriptions.

useCases.title: Add a customer, contact, note or quote
useCases.text: The AI creates a customer, adds a contact to one, writes a note for your team, or creates a quote from existing items. No invoice is made and no email is sent.

useCases.title: Correct a customer's details
useCases.text: The AI changes fields of an existing customer. It cannot touch payment methods, balances or status.
